detail: The test asserts pathAndQuery '/user/orders?status=StockConfirmed' after the click and '/user/orders' after 'Show all orders', but no keyframe shows either URL. The captions at :334 and :352 fade before frames 03-06 and 07-09 are captured. Re-caption the URL right before the .orders-filter-empty highlight and before the final list highlight, or put the URL in those highlight labels. [raised by opus, sol]

Minor: the 'After the live refresh' URL caption appears in no frame (05-08). The requested ?status=Paid shows only in frame 02, before the refresh. The state after the refresh (102 only, Paid selected) is visible.

Minor: frame 04 shows the caption 'After clicking All: .../user/orders' over the old screen (only 103, Shipped selected). The re-render lands in frame 06. TC-10 frame 04 has the same timing. Caption after the state assertion instead.

The test asserts pathAndQuery === '/user/orders?status=Paid' and calls demo.caption('After clicking Paid: <url>'), but none of the frames after the click (04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09) shows any caption or the URL. Only the pre-click 'Opened .../user/orders' caption ever renders. The case's 'address becomes /user/orders?status=Paid' line is not visible in the recording. [raised by opus, sol]

After clicking All, the case requires the URL /user/orders with no query. The test's 'After clicking All' caption does not appear in frames 04 to 08. The only URL shown is the pre-click '?status=Shipped' (frame 02), so the dropped parameter is never shown. [raised by opus, sol]

Neither post-click URL appears in any frame: /user/orders?status=StockConfirmed after step 2 (frames 03 to 05) and /user/orders with no query after 'Show all orders' (frame 07). The captions the test sets at ordst-1.spec.ts:342 and :355 do not render. [raised by opus, sol]

Minor. After the live refresh, the 'After the live refresh: <url>' caption is missing from frames 05 to 09, and the earlier 'Opened ...?status=Paid' caption (frame 02) is gone too. The 'URL is still /user/orders?status=Paid' line is shown only indirectly, by Paid still selected with no reload.
